description: Exact-match Trivy suppressions applied by scripts/trivy-image-scan.mjs. A row matches only when image, package, installed version AND CVE id all equal the finding, so any version change re-surfaces it. Suppressed rows are still logged and kept in the retained report.

suppressions.justification: Fixed in Pillow 13.0.0, but /opt/docling-venv is locked by eval/docling/requirements.txt (docling 2.139.0) to pillow 12.3.0; Docling caps Pillow <13. Matching Dependabot alerts were dismissed for the same reason. NOT remediated: risk accepted for the shadow-extraction venv only.
suppressions.remove_when: Docling allows Pillow>=13 and the docling lab lock is regenerated (npm run generate:docling-lab-lock)
